kevin.dev: FYI forwarding an email I got that's asking to reauthorize CI tokens for 'CircleCI - Redwood Integrations'. Link looks off (circleci.reauth[.]tools). Anyone can triage?
phishbot: Suspicious email detected by phishbot. Links: circleci.reauth.tools flagged by URL reputation (score 87).
sarah.sec: Thanks, Kevin. Can you paste headers and the raw email? Did you click?
kevin.dev: Didn't sign in, just clicked link to inspect and browser warned 'Deceptive site ahead' so closed. Here's the raw headers I copied:
```
Return-Path: <mailer@circleci-service.com>
Received: from mail-45-33-21-10.prod by mx.redwood.com with ESMTPS id 123abc
From: CircleCI Integrations <no-reply@circleci-service.com>
Subject: Action required: Reauthorize your CI tokens
Reply-To: support@circleci-service.com
Links: https://circleci.reauth.tools/reauth
```
sarah.sec: OK running sandbox detonation now. CC @james-oncall in case we need to rotate tokens/cancel CI jobs.
james-oncall: Oncall here. Any evidence of token exfil or CI job triggered?
sarah.sec: Sandbox run shows staged credential capture form POST to https://auth-collect[.]info/api/collect with fields `VCS_TOKEN, USER` and JS that tries to POST to third-party. No malware dropper. Observed network calls to s3 bucket.
sarah.sec: Sanitized sandbox log:
```
2024-11-02T15:12:01Z GET /reauth 200 OK
2024-11-02T15:12:05Z POST /api/collect 200 OK body: {"vcs_token":"[REDACTED]","user":"kevin.dev"}
2024-11-02T15:12:06Z CONNECT s3.amazonaws.com/exfil-logs-001/put 403 Forbidden
```
elena-ops: I'll add domain and IP to egress blocklists and put WAF rule to drop requests to auth-collect.info. Also I'll trigger rotation for all CircleCI service tokens that had activity in last 7d — we should scope.
james-oncall: Requested list of potentially affected apps from platform. @kevin.dev which repos did you open link from?
kevin.dev: Personal laptop, browser session with 3 tabs — repo: infra/cicd-config and infra/deploy-scripts. I did not log into circleci.
sarah.sec: Ok thanks. Action items:
- elena-ops: block domains/IPs and WAF rules
- james-oncall: rotate tokens for CI integrations with last-activity in 7d
- sarah.sec: run audit for token exchange logs and SIEM rule
- maria-legal: review for PII exfil and comms
- sarah.sec: create incident INC-202311-1337 and follow-up writeup
maria-legal: Thanks — will review and prepare external/internal comm templates.
sarah.sec: Sandbox IOC summary: circleci.reauth.tools -> 45.33.21.10 (ASXYZ), auth-collect.info -> 3.12.210.9. Observed UA 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT) reauth-fetch/1.0'. Blocking both. No binary artifacts.
elena-ops: Blocked IPs on perimeter and updated WAF. Created SIEM rule to alert on POSTs to /api/collect and on unusual UA 'reauth-fetch/1.0'. Pushed urgent runbook 'rotate_ci_tokens' to infra team.
james-oncall: Rotating tokens in progress — invalidated 4 deployment tokens and issued new ephemeral keys pinned to RBAC. ETA 60m.
sarah.sec: Preparing dev comms: short note + examples of the phishing subject 'Action required: Reauthorize your CI tokens' and spoofed From header 'CircleCI Integrations <no-reply@circleci-service.com>'. Will include indicators and screenshots.
kevin.dev: Thanks for fast response. Quick ask — can we add an automated check to PR template reminding not to paste tokens? I also saw creds in a gist last month.
elena-ops: Good idea. Adding a pre-commit check and repository scan for token-like strings for commits pushed in last 30d.
sarah.sec: Closing triage summary: domains/IPs blocked, tokens rotated, SIEM rule added, awareness comms scheduled, legal review in flight. Follow-ups: incident writeup + phishing simulation next week. Final summary to be posted to #all-devs after legal signs off. INC-202311-1337
sarah.sec: :white_check_mark:
